NDD Abuja · Our first location

Abuja

A planned capital with room to experiment. Abuja's wide avenues, modernist civic buildings and fast-growing neighbourhoods make it one of the most interesting places in Nigeria to build and design right now. Lagos has its design week; Abuja has had no equivalent. NDD Abuja is the first district under the Nigeria Design District umbrella.
